text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while on an outing with Mejiro Palmer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer points toward a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aren't they just the cutest ever?! Oh! Never seen that one before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios and I actually play these claw machine games a lot. We even snagged a BIG prize a while ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios put it on her phone as a charm and then got all mad 'cause it wouldn't fit in her bag! It was hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: These plushies are a pretty good size, though. I bet they'd look great hanging from my bag.
choice_data_list: I'll win you one so you can see how it looks!
I'll win you one so you can see how it looks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ooh! You're just jumping at the chance to try, aren'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, then! Here, I'll even cheer for you while you play!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
